ayahOccurrences.text: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًا مَّهِيلًا
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًا مَّهِيلًا

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: مَّهِيلًا is in the derivative form: مَهِيلٌ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
هـ/ي/ل   h–y–l to pour down, to slide down, (of sand or earth in a pit) to trickle down, to heap up (sand or earth), to cause to pour down, avalanching sand dunes, to gang up; a halo. Of this root, مَهِيلٌ mahıl occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
مَهِيلٌ mahıl [quasi‐pass. part.] made to avalanche, caused to slide down, made to collapse

(73:14) يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ الأَرْضُ وَالْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ الْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًا مَهِيلاً on the Day when the earth and the mountains will tremble and the mountains will become collapsing sand dunes.
